admission.justification: The numeric floor, no-uv-procurement boundary and pre-mutation refusal jointly protect machine-tool ownership and usable environments; none alone supplies the whole setup boundary.

guarantee: Host worktree setup uses a readable machine PATH uv meeting the contract numeric floor without procuring uv; unsupported uv is refused before runtime or environment mutation. Numeric admission alone, no procurement alone, and early refusal alone do not establish this whole boundary.
title: Machine uv admission before environment mutation
